response.original_title: Những Người Lính Bị Bỏ Rơi
response.overview: "Những Người Lính Bị Bỏ Rơi" (The Abandoned Soldiers) is a special music program, historical documentary, and album produced by SBTN (Saigon Broadcasting Television Network) and musician Trúc Hồ. It was released on April 30, 2020, to mark the 45th anniversary of the Fall of Saigon.
response.title: The forsaken soldiers
